retrieved_rules.title: Purpose of this Part
retrieved_rules.own_text:
For the purposes of paragraphs 112(2)(c) and (f) of the Act, this Part prescribes
requirements that must be met for the establishment to be registered for a kind of
export operations in relation to a kind of prescribed plants or plant products.
retrieved_rules.text:
4-1 Purpose of this Part
Purpose of this Part
For the purposes of paragraphs 112(2)(c) and (f) of the Act, this Part prescribes
requirements that must be met for the establishment to be registered for a kind of
export operations in relation to a kind of prescribed plants or plant products.

(1) A registered establishment must be kept in a condition:

retrieved_rules.label: (b)
retrieved_rules.own_text:
(b) that ensures that prescribed plants and plant products at the establishment
are not, or not likely to be, infested by pests or contaminated.

anchors.quote: The establishment has the buildings, equipment, facilities and services required for the type of export operations being conducted.

An establishment must have the buildings, equipment, facilities and services that are necessary to ensure that export operations in relation to prescribed plants or plant products can be carried out in a way that will ensure that the requirements of the Act are complied with.
An establishment must have handwashing and toilet facilities.
An establishment and its equipment and facilities must be designed and constructed:
areas that are suitable for assessments of prescribed plants or plant products to be carried out; and
to minimise the possibility of infestation or contamination of prescribed plants or plant products during export operations; and
to provide for the disposal of all waste material (including liquids and solids) in an appropriate and hygienic manner; and
to facilitate safe and effective treatments of prescribed plants and plant products; and
to allow samples of prescribed plants and plant products to be taken.

If testing and analysis of samples of prescribed plants or plant products or other things is to be carried out at an establishment, the establishment and its equipment and facilities must be designed and constructed to allow the testing and analysis to be carried out.
the establishment and its equipment and facilities must be designed and constructed to allow the screening to be carried out.
The requirements for registration of an establishment prescribed by section 4-2 must continue to be met in relation to a registered establishment after it is registered.
A registered establishment must be kept in a condition:
appropriate for the export operations carried out at the establishment and the plants or plant products at the property;
the establishment must be kept in a clean and hygienic condition appropriate for the export operations carried out at the establishment and the kind of plants or plant products;
pests and contaminants at the establishment must be controlled in a manner that is appropriate for the export operations and the kind of prescribed plants or plant products;

notes: The CP criterion is a single broad requirement. Multiple legal provisions elaborate this requirement but do not create independent cumulative obligations. Therefore, a single satisfaction atom is used with multiple legal bases.
Candidates with contract_eligible=false were excluded from basis_candidate_ids as required.
No ALL/ANY structure is used because the validated RuleSetRelation indicates SUPPORTS_SAME_CRITERION and SPECIALIZES relationships, not cumulative or alternative connectors.
